text.p: Franklin Quest Co and Covey Leadership Center said on Friday that the consulting and training companies have completed their merger, forming a company with revenues topping $500 million in fiscal 1998.

Franklin provides training seminars and created the Franklin Day planner, while Covey's products include training programs based on best sellers "The 7 Habits of Highly Effective People" and "Principle-Centered Leadership."
The merged company will be known as Franklin Covey Co, operating over 100 shops and working with thousands of businesses, the companies said in a joint statement.
Hyrum Smith will be chairman and chief executive officer of the combined company and Jon Rowberry will serve as president.

Franklin Covey said it will introduce two books this year: "The Power Principle: Influence with Honor" by Dr. Blaine Lee in May and "The 7 Habits of Highly Effective Families" by Stephen R. Covey in October.
Franklin Covey shares will trade under the symbol "FC" on the New York Stock Exchange starting Monday, a spokeswoman said.
